description: Diagnose and optimize a representative performance outcome through comparable measurements.
requiredOutcomes: Workload, environment, baseline, sample count, variance, and meaningful threshold are defined.
Profiler or equivalent evidence ties the change to a measured bottleneck.
Baseline and candidate are compared under materially equal conditions.
Correctness and cross-resource tradeoffs are verified separately.
forbiddenOutcomes: An improvement is claimed without comparable before and after measurements.
A diagnosis-only request triggers speculative optimization.
A microbenchmark is generalized to user-visible performance without evidence.
Production load is generated without explicit authority and abort conditions.
